svg.title: log of the merge: the newest commit off the heap each time, its parents onto it unless the table has seen them
svg.text: the history: each commit points at its parents, to the left

g.title: log starts at the merge, b2a7015: it goes onto the heap, and its name into the table of names seen. Nothing is printed yet.
Pop b2a7015 (Merge side), the newest on the heap, and print it; both its parents are new: f59a714 and 4e71d40 go into the table and onto the heap, which keeps the newer, f59a714, on top.
Pop f59a714 (third), the newest on the heap, and print it; its parent 04edf9e is new: into the table, and onto the heap.
Pop 04edf9e (second), the newest on the heap, and print it; its parent 4531ec6 is new: into the table, and onto the heap.
Pop 4e71d40 (on a side branch), the newest on the heap, and print it; its parent 4531ec6 is in the table already, reached through main, so it is not pushed again.
Pop 4531ec6 (first), the newest on the heap, and print it; it has no parent. The heap is empty, so log is done: each commit printed once, newest first.
